pages.rules:
Carefully study this section of the rules; by following them, you have nothing to fear.

 

Hexlash is not just a game, it's your path to self-improvement and freedom. Every member of the club goes through trials. You must not only win fights but also find your own purpose, build communities, and help other members on their journey.

 

The first rule of Hexlash:

Tell everyone about Hexlash. Hexlash is not a game, it's your path to freedom. Share this freedom with others.

 

The second rule of Hexlash:

Find meaning. Hexlash has a purpose, and every player must achieve it to become part of the club.

 

The third rule of Hexlash:

Be honest with your own. Anyone who tries to deceive the club will be banned forever.

 

The fourth rule of Hexlash:

If you have something to say — say it. Any advice and help are welcome. Your activity is valued by the club.

 

The fifth rule of Hexlash:

You can quit at any moment. There is a 'Delete Account' button in the 'Profile/Settings' section.

 

 

The main rules reflect the core principles: share, achieve your goals, be honest, speak up, and don't give up.

 

Share freedom:

When you become part of Hexlash, you take on the responsibility of its development. Tell others about the club, invite friends, share your experience. Hexlash is not a solitary path, but a brotherhood united by a common goal.

 

Find your purpose:

Each member of the club should strive for their personal goal. It could be winning fights, building the strongest club, or finding yourself through participation. Once you've achieved your goal, you become not just a fighter but a full-fledged member of Hexlash.

 

Honesty is everything:

There is no place for deceit or lies here. Hexlash exists thanks to trust. Any attempt to deceive other members or the club will result in immediate expulsion. Honesty is the foundation of relationships between fighters.

 

Activity creates value:

Don’t be afraid to speak up, share your opinions, and help others. Your activity within the club is essential for its growth. Advice, ideas, suggestions — these are the things that make the club stronger. If you see how the community can be improved, don’t stay silent — your voice matters.

 

It’s your choice:

You can leave at any moment. It’s important to understand that participation in Hexlash is a choice. If you feel that your mission is complete or you no longer want to participate, you always have the option to delete your account in the settings.

 

For detailed information, check out the help section
